delivery.rule: A delivery promise is only a data point if the page PRINTED the zip we requested. verified:false rows never enter the heatmap.
delivery.basis: One capture run per city with a pinned session; the zip is set through each retailer's own control and every row re-reads the zip the page printed. Only rows whose printed zip matches enter this table.

bestbuy.why: Best Buy renders a ~4-item featured strip to logged-out sessions (same items across all 3 passes — Hisense on 4k tv, Marshall on wireless speaker), not a result grid. A share computed on 4 placements is noise; the strip looks paid, and organic share cannot be derived from it.

shelf.basis: Organic placements only (sponsored excluded), accessories and renewed excluded, mean of 3 passes per term.
